cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Let me have the medal for the charity auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only thing I've ever won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then it should raise more than the toaster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I lend it for the display? I still want people to know I won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then present it to the buyer yourself. I'll print your name in the programme; everyone will know whose medal was worth giving up.

mechanism: A frames giving up a cherished medal as the next stage of the achievement it claims to have taught B.
confusable: It is persuasion to surrender ownership, not just lending an object or offering general encouragement.
comparison: Public recognition exchanged for a medal versus household need and an emotionally valuable guitar.
seedUse: D12 auction and wish to remain recognized remain; S05 progression beyond beginner achievement provides the pressure.
